safety_controls.pii_masking: Emails and 10-digit mobile numbers are replaced before model calls.
safety_controls.input_limit: Inputs are truncated to 180 words after masking.
safety_controls.structured_output: JSON is parsed and category labels are validated against an allow-list.
safety_controls.retry_policy: Transient model failures receive up to 3 attempts.
safety_controls.fallback: Malformed output, invalid labels, and exhausted retries use deterministic keyword fallback.
